signals.rationale: The speaker maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering his statement. His voice is clear and steady, and he speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation.

The man maintains steady eye contact and actively listens to the speaker's statements. He responds with the challenging question, "So, what's that prove?", delivered with a questioning tone. This verbal challenge, combined with his direct gaze, clearly demonstrates a doubting stance toward the information presented.
